title: Switchyard benchmark task
description: Documentation of the shape validated by backend/app/models/benchmark.py:BenchmarkTaskSchema. Not enforced programmatically (Pydantic already validates at load time) — kept here as a stable, tool-agnostic reference.

id.description: Unique task id. Must match the JSON file's name (without extension).

prompt.description: The exact input sent to each model.

expected_output.description: Required for exact_match/classification_label. For valid_json, an optional JSON object literal whose keys are checked against the response's keys. Omit or null for manual.

metadata.description: Free-form: tags, notes, anything not needed by evaluation logic.
